headline: Weathered Expanse Tilts Colonial as Callahan's Passage Rages
war_summary: Since our last edition the scales have tipped on Weathered Expanse: works that stood four apiece at noon now read six Colonial against three Warden, after the war's busiest ground logged fifty-six actions about Wightwalk and Frostmarch. Callahan's Passage burns as fiercely as ever; The Latch, fought over ten times in the day, rests again under the Warden flag, and the front's twenty-four-hour toll tops nineteen thousand with the hourly rate still climbing as we go to press. Stlican Shelf counted forty actions, second only to Weathered Expanse, Breaker Town and The Pale House still at their wrestling, the latest blow struck within the half-hour. Stonecradle's Trammel Pool took fresh punishment, while Linn of Mercy, its flags unmoved since mid-morning, bleeds at above thirteen hundred an hour. Godcrofts, Fisherman's Row and the Viper Pit have seen no flag movements for hours. In the Dead Lands no banner has stirred in twenty hours, though the casualty columns swell. The ledger stands at 282 works Colonial, 153 Warden, one in ruins — a net gain of two to the Colonials since our last accounting. It is day 193; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
